s.note: Casey shaking the pan while the phone rings
s.how: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels in a heavy covered pot. When they pop, add 120g kernels and shake constantly until the popping slows. Tip out and toss with 50g melted butter and fine salt.
Dice 4 tomatoes, half a red onion and a jalapeño. Mix with chopped coriander, the juice of a lime and salt, and leave 10 minutes to get juicy. Serve with a 300g bag of corn chips.

m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties and grill to medium, melting cheddar on top under a lid. Build on toasted buns with iceberg, tomato, onion and burger sauce. Fry 1kg potatoes cut into fries, twice.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Cut into long ovals and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Ice white with 300g icing sugar mixed with egg white, then pipe the face in black icing.

d.how: Fill an esky with a bag of ice and some water and bury eight 355ml bottles of American lager for an hour. Hand them out, and don't answer the phone.
